title: See AI PK Reports in action
summary: Watch how Model Designer brings cloud based pharmacometric modeling to your browser, with guided wizards, live PML editing, and AI assistance from Certara.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


Get a quick look at AI PK Reports, Certara’s generative AI tool for turning TFLs into a structured draft report. This short video shows the idea behind the workflow, so scientists can spend more time interpreting results and less time assembling them. Contact us for a full demo.


### View transcript


Take the heavy lifting out of PKPD reporting.


Turn complex study data into a structured draft with just a few clicks. Simply upload your existing Phoenix outputs and study protocols into AI PK reports.


The AI extracts vital text and tables, preserving your original figures. Generate comprehensive memos in minutes, not hours. The final output is a fully editable Word document. Review your draft with confidence.


Documents arrive pre populated with precise study numbers and key PK parameters. Best of all, you can easily build custom report templates inside the platform, ensuring every draft perfectly matches your company’s official layout from the start.


## Reduce PK report creation time from days to just minutes


Automate the drudge work and get to the decisions. AI PK Reports accelerates the generation of PK documents by leveraging AI-powered templates and pre-defined prompts.


[Learn more](https://www.certara.com/software/phoenix-pkpd/phoenix-cloud/ai-pk-reports/)
